name: Swing
about: A wooden swing on two posts, with a seat hanging from fences.

layers.name: Gravel
layers.tip: On flat grass, swap a square of grass in the middle for gravel, 3 by 3.

layers.name: Posts
layers.tip: Put a log at each end, with one square of grass between each log and the gravel.

layers.name: Seat
layers.tip: Two more logs on the posts. The seat is three oak slabs hanging from the ropes, so leave it for the very end.

layers.name: Ropes
layers.tip: Two more logs on the posts. The fences here are ropes that hang from the beam, so add them at the end too.

layers.name: Tops of the posts
layers.tip: One more log on each post. Two more rope fences, also for the end.

layers.name: Beam
layers.tip: Join the posts with spruce planks across the top. Now hang the ropes: two fences down from the beam on each side. Then put the slab seat under them.
